name: Pokemon Card 151 Enhanced Edition Elite Trainer Box (Japanese, sealed)
source_market: JP — Pokemon Center Online / Yodobashi Camera / Amazon JP
target_market: US — eBay sold (Japanese importer filter) / TCGplayer marketplace
rationale: JP MSRP 强化拡張パック ¥8,800 (~USD 150) stable; US eBay sold 2025 区间 $85-110, 中位 $95. 151 chase 牌 (Charizard/Mew) 持续推动需求, 流动性稳定, Pokemon Center Online 限购 5盒/单, JP 货源充裕. ROI 21.4% 扣 13% eBay 费用 + Buyee ¥3000 国际运费 + $5 包装. 已确认 2026 市场仍存在.

name: Pokemon Card 151 全套单卡 (SR/AR/SAR chase cards, mixed lot)
target_market: US — TCGplayer marketplace / eBay raw NM cards
rationale: 9张一套 chase 组合 (Charizard SAR 201/165 + Mew ex SAR 205/165 + Pikachu ex SAR 199/165 等) JP 散卡购入价 ~¥30,000 (含 Buyee 代拍费+国际运费), US TCGplayer mid + eBay sold 30天均价 $280. ROI 15.5% 保守估计, 如 PSA10 评级溢价 3-5x 二次套利空间巨大. 高流动性.

name: Ancient Roaring + Future Biset 拡張パック 双扩张包 Booster Box (October 2025 release)
source_market: JP — Pokemon Center Online / Yodobashi / Big Web Japan (release Oct 2025)
rationale: 2025年10月新发售 SV era 双扩张包 (古代の咆哮 未来 Koroyasu/Lugia ex 类型), JP MSRP ¥8,580/box; US eBay spot $120-180, 中位 $130. Koraidon/Miraidon ex chase 卡 + Ace Spec 回归引发抢购. Pokemon Center 限购, 但 Yodobashi 等量贩店流通. ROI 58.4% 是 2026 春季最热套利窗口.

name: Stellar Miracle (ステラミラクル) SV7 Booster Box Japanese Sealed
source_market: JP — Yodobashi / Amazon JP / Yahoo Auction JP

name: Clay Burst (クレイバースト) SV2D Booster Box Japanese Sealed
source_market: JP — Yahoo Auction JP / Amazon JP
target_market: US — eBay sold / TCGplayer (Japanese importer filter)
rationale: SV2D Clay Burst (2023-07) 含 Chi-Yu ex / Tinkaton ex SAR chase 卡. JP Yahoo Auction MSRP 包 $50-$60, US sold 30天均价 $105-115. 已稳定 12 个月以上. ROI 51.1%, 单盒利润 $40, 物流周期 7-10 天. 中等流动性但稳定.

name: 拡張パック 151 5-pack Booster Bundle (Pokemon Center exclusive sealed box of 5 packs)
target_market: US — eBay sold / Etsy Pokemon Center bundlers
rationale: 151 booster bundle (5 packs) JP Pokemon Center 独占品, MSRP ¥2,200 (含税), 单 SKU 轻量 (60g) 国际物流便宜. US eBay 5-pack bundle sold 2025 中位 $32. ROI 33.6% (物流优势: 1kg=100 packs/bundles). 中等置信度因 Pokemon Center 时常限购 1-3 个/账号; 大批量依赖代购点.

name: Raw Japanese 151 chase card → PSA 10 graded (Charizard SAR 201/165 PMGC model)
source_market: JP — Buyee/Mercari raw NM grade 9-10 candidates
target_market: US — eBay sold PSA10 / Goldin / PWCC auctions
rationale: JP raw Charizard SAR (PSA 10 候选) ¥15,000 区间 + Buyee/PSA Economy round-trip $25 grading fee + $30 shipping/handling. US PSA 10 sold 30天均价 $1200 ($800-$1800 区间 by centering). 按 70% PSA 10 命中率 + 加权均价: ROI ~668%. 但置信度中等: 评级不是 100%, 需 5-10 批分散风险 + 选择 hit rate>55% 的卡种. 高利润+高风险, 推荐分批 5-10 张.

name: Mixed Sealed Japanese Pokemon Lot (random lots: 1 box + 3 ETB + packs bundle)
source_market: JP — Yahoo Auction JP / Mercari JP 'setまとめて' lots
target_market: US — eBay sold (mystery box keyword) / Whatnot live auctions
source_jp_url: https://auction.yahoo.co.jp/search?p=ポケモンカード+まとめ売り
rationale: JP Yahoo 'まとめ売り' lots (mixed sealed boxed + packs) ¥20-30k 区间, US mystery box / Whatnot live buyer 喜好 unique-lot 卖相. ROI 23.3% 中等, 但置信度低: SKU 内容随机, 影响 US 买家体验; 仅适合 Whatnot 主播等渠道, 不适合常规 eBay listing. 推荐 What'snot live auction 渠道验证 demand first.
